source.author: verg
source.text: Deus aethere missus ab alto festinare fugam tortosque incidere funes ecce iterum stimulat.
source.text_original: Deus aethere missus ab alto / festinare fugam tortosque incidere funes / ecce iterum stimulat.
source.text_english: A god sent down from the high heavens again urges them to hasten their flight and cut the twisted ropes.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: at quibus arvorum studiumque insontis aratri, hos stimulant magnaque ratem per lustra viasque visi laude canunt manifesto in lumine Fauni silvarumque deae atque elatis cornibus Amnes.
reuse.text_original: at quibus arvorum studiumque insontis aratri, / hos stimulant magnaque ratem per lustra viasque / visi laude canunt manifesto in lumine Fauni / silvarumque deae atque elatis cornibus Amnes.
reuse.text_english: But those in whom there is a passion for the fields and for the guiltless plough, these are spurred on; and, as they are seen, they sing of the raft through the years and roads with great praise, in clear light, along with Fauni, the goddesses of the woods, and the Rivers with uplifted horns.
